newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were steady to lower in the after-hours session on Thursday after most contracts hit their life-of-contract lows during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 0.6 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark March was unchanged at 133.7 yen.
The market opened weaker amid continued bearish sentiment. Volume was high with 15,579 lots traded.
"Market sentiment was further dampened technically after most contracts hit their life-of-contract lows today. Prices are likely to fall further," one trader said.
